functions.briefZh: 读取卡当前的状态（idle / ready / transfer 等）。

functions.name: HAL_SD_Abort

params.name: hsd
params.descEn: pointer to a SD_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for SD module.

functions.briefEn: Abort the current transfer and disable the SD.
functions.briefZh: 中止正在进行的传输（阻塞式，等外设真正停下才返回）。

functions.name: HAL_SD_Abort_IT

params.name: hsd
params.descEn: pointer to a SD_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for SD module.

functions.briefEn: Abort the current transfer and disable the SD (IT mode).
functions.briefZh: 以中断方式中止传输，中止完成后回调 AbortCpltCallback。
